text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I came to the cafeteria
to have lunch—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
NOOOOO!!
I messed up biiiig tiiiime!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My vital source of power...
I ended up forgetting my special Salsa Vida.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Without that, El just...
can't get that hot-hot energy pumping...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I don't think I can keep going this afternoon eitheeeer...
